versions.changelog:
Initial release with features tailored for local interior designers on Xiaohongshu:

- Generates localized, IP-driven post topics, titles, content, and tags.
- Recommends trending and region-specific daily topics.
- Provides 5 optimized title options for higher click-through rates.
- Auto-generates suitable local tags for increased visibility.
- Simple workflow: clarify positioning and theme, receive ready-to-publish content.
